rationale: Independent reading: held EO 13371 (70 FR 5041) rewrites EO 13285 secs. 2(a)-(b) and sets sec. 4(b) expiry Jan. 29, 2007 'unless further extended'. Held EO 13424 (72 FR 4409) moves expiry to Nov. 30, 2008; held EO 13471 (73 FR 51209) sec. 2: 'Unless further extended by the President, this order shall expire on June 30, 2009.' EO 13371 has effect only as text of EO 13285, which by its own (amended) sunset expired June 30, 2009. My own status: NO; agree. D6: EO 13424 and 13471 are the only later held orders naming EO 13285; both are extensions before the final date and are walked in the rationale; no held order extends or re-establishes the Council after June 30, 2009 (held-text hits for 13285: only 13285, 13371, 13424, 13471). The USC 42 U.S.C. 12651 note lead prints EO 13285 'as amended by' 13371/13424/13471 and is not evidence of continuing force. Residual: a non-EO extension is not excluded by the EO-only corpus. Accept.
